name: masar
description: Masar | مسار — shipping company management SaaS

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @masar/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @masar/shared" "npm run dev -w @masar/server" "npm run dev -w @masar/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @masar/shared && npm run build -w @masar/server && npm run build -w @masar/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @masar/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @masar/shared && npm run build -w @masar/server && npm run seed -w @masar/server
